title: NEWS
text: Initial development release. tidydragen nemo child package parses tidies outputs Illumina DRAGEN pipelines wide-format tidy tibbles ready data warehouse, writing parquet, TSV, CSV, RDS, database. following pipelines supported starters: DNA tumor-normal (somatic), DNA germline-, RNA tumor-, ctTSO500 (DRAGEN TSO500 ctDNA app layer). Six domain tools, inst/config/tools/<tool>/schema.yaml, inheriting intermediate DragenTool base (inherit = nemo::Tool) orchestrated Dragen workflow class (exported DRAGEN_TOOLS), tolerates absent files pipeline can expose different subset. DragenMap: mapping/time metrics, fragment-length histogram, cttso trimmer / UMI / GC-bias metrics. DragenFqc: 8 flat per-section FastQC tables. DragenCov: coverage metrics/bins/cumulative, contig mean, fine histogram, cov-report-bed tables across every region (wgs/tmb/exon/target_bed/ qc-coverage-region-*) phenotype. DragenVar: variant/SV/CNV/ploidy/TMB/HRD/gVCF metrics plus microsatellite (JSON), native ploidy-VCF parse, contamination (JSON). DragenRna: fusion quant metrics. DragenTso: ctTSO app-layer (pr3). *_metrics.csv files share headerless section,rg,variable,count[,pct] shape. DragenTool registers dragen-metrics ftype: plain metrics table parsed pivoted wide (one column per mapped metric plus paired <metric>_pct) per-table code; tables needing custom split region/chrom normalise hook declare explicit tidy_<table>() one-liners. Fail-loud policies (on_unmapped, on_coerce_fail, on_unexpected_col) catch schema drift instead silently dropping data. pr3 DragenTso parses TSO500 ctDNA outputs beyond shared DRAGEN metrics: CombinedVariantOutput small variants, Fusions, TMB trace/msaf, exon/gene coverage, 6-way fan-SampleAnalysisResults.json. pr8 Test fixtures rebuilt real DRAGEN pipeline outputs (trimmed per file), real sample IDs scrubbed sampleA/sampleB, tracked DVC Cloudflare R2 remote. default remote public-read, fresh clone CI run fetches fixtures dvc pull credentials. @testexamples assertions updated real-data values; roxytest suite passes. CLI, conda recipe, multi-arch (amd64 + arm64) Docker image (pr6). GitHub Actions version bumping deploy, refactored reusable tidywf/actions workflows tag-triggered (pr4, pr5). Vignettes: installation, quickstart, structure, schema table, output naming, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, UML.

One tool, one schema.yaml, one output category. tool owns single, focused schema scoped group; tool name becomes category token every output name (e.g. <prefix>_dragencov_finehist), table’s origin self-documenting. Independent evolution. Adding, versioning, fixing one group’s schema touches tool, keeping shared metrics logic DragenTool base untouched. shared machinery still lives one place. text: Intermediate base class tidydragen tools. Inherits nemo::Tool adds DRAGEN-specific shared logic e.g. metrics parser/tidier used every *_metrics.csv table. Tools like DragenCov inherit DragenTool rather nemo::Tool directly. dragen-metrics ftype registered (parse via extra_ftypes(), tidy via tidy_file override), plain metrics table needs methods, just ftype: 'dragen-metrics' schema. table needing normalise/drop_constant still declares explicit tidy_<tbl>() delegates tidy_metrics.

title: DragenTool Object — DragenTool
text: DRAGEN *_metrics.csv files share headerless 4/5-column shape: section, rg, variable, count[, pct]. rg (read-group / sample) empty sections populated e.g. fastqc per-sample variant sections. value column (count) read character since metrics carry string values (e.g. Ploidy estimation = "XX") counts can exceed 32-bit range; tidy column coerced schema type wide pivot.

title: DragenTool Object — DragenTool
text: on_unmapped (character(1)) Policy metrics present *_metrics.csv file absent schema. error refuses drop data aborts, schema drift (e.g. new DRAGEN version adds metric) fails loudly rather silently omitting column. Set warn instead drop unmapped metrics warning. on_coerce_fail (character(1)) Policy non-empty metric value fails coercion schema numeric type (becomes NA). error aborts rather losing value; usually wrong schema type (char) unexpected string. Set warn keep NA warning. Genuine missings (NA/empty file) never trigger . on_unexpected_col (character(1)) Policy id column named tidy_metrics(drop_constant=) expected constant (dropped) instead varies across rows. error aborts rather letting surprise extra column appear output table (schema drift data lake). Set warn keep unexpected column warning. Tables legitimately vary section/rg opt via drop_constant = character() never trip .

Feed tokens fastqc_bin_open() first open-ended bins (256+, >=255) collapsed single bound.
